'pCVar1[1].actor_name + 0x10' walks 1 x sizeof(CDemonActor) (0x2b4) + offsetof(actor_name) (0x0) + 0x10 = 0x2c4, which is exactly offsetof(CActorDestination, dest_class[12]). Ghidra had no CActorDestination type here and reached the field by index arithmetic; write it as ((CActorDestination *)pCVar1)->dest_class[12] (§de-pun/§12). Ambiguous: CBarrier::effect_class_name_list, CBat::course_filename[16], CEmitter::emitter_state also has a field there — confirm the real class from the .asm before rewriting.
